reviews.x: First time using it tonight. Pulled the hair a little at first, probably due to my hair being a bit long to start. After a few seconds of shaving everything felt fine.  Very quiet and effective. I needed to use a mirror to see where I was shaving and the lights helped a lot in finding the areas to shave. My head is now completely bald.  I would highly recommend this shaver.
One of the prongs stayed stuck in plug and now it won't charge.

I don't know if it was designed for the head, buy I just bought it and it works great! 5 heads is Super fast for my head.strong and a great finish. I think this is a great product independently of the price. But great price + great work is a perfect match. If you want a great product for cheap this is the shaver you need.

Stopped working after 4th use.  Initially when I got this product I was concerned about the quality.  It's made of very cheap plastic and felt like it would break easily.  I gave it a shot anyway and put it to use.  After a 2 hour charge I used it on my head and face.  Seemed to work well except my face was really red after use.  Second day I used it on my head no prob.  Seemed to have less power so I charged it again.  3rd day, same thing.  Used on my head, cleaned it and put it away.  4th day,

reviews.t: Have to commend it for its bonus function
reviews.x: Have received it for almost for a month. I didn’t intend to leave a review until yesterday night. For the reason I bought it as a shaver, it was as good as my expectation. It was a good shaver for its price, my husband used it every day and didn’t complain anything. But that was it.  Until yesterday Night, I used the brush head to clean my toddler girl’s beloved sneaker. The shoes were shining after I cleaned it using the shaver with the brush head on! Believe me, before the cleaning, the shoes

I have tried 2 of these products and they just don't hold.  Each time they have lasted about 5 months with light usage.  The product starts out fine but then something happens and then it stops working. For the most recent one the rotors stopped rotating and then the power started waning. I attempted cleaning it  and next thing I knew the power, wasn't coming up at all.  I think I will bite the bullet and buy one from a more reputable company.

reviews.t: It's a decent product for the price.
reviews.x: Pro: Kind of easy to clean. Has a nice light. Good for the price. Easy to hold.  Cons: It doesnt shave close enough for a bald head but still not bad. Battery life is limited to about 1 use. My neck is tender to shaving so its pretty rough on me to use shavers. (I havent found one that cuts so it doesnt bother me)  It's a decent product for the price. I personally think it should be cheaper though.

reviews.t: Leaves something to be desired (that something is hair)
reviews.x: I use this razor to shave my head. I thought the design looked practical and cool so I thought I’d try it out. The blades are rather dull if you’re looking for a close shave on your head. I had to go over the same spot multiple times to get a tight shave. I was excited to try this product but ended up more disappointed than not. Would not recommend for anyone who wants to use this  on their head.

reviews.t: Use daily for the best results
reviews.x: I usually read the most reviews,but lazy to write one. I thought I have to for this razor. Very quickly shipping. It has a nice motor.I’ve been using it for a week and l can honestly say I am still excited everytime I shave.5 blade head is so sweet.And easily to cleaned up. I have to recommend it. I believe that it is the finest shaver of our time at this moment .

reviews.t: My cousin was surprised of this shaver
reviews.x: I bought this shaver for my cousins birthday and he was super surprised when he opened. It has literally everything that he might need for grooming. It has a 5 headed shaver, a hair trimmer, nose trimmer and cleaner for his face. He was happy and thanked me for the purchase, which made me gave me the reason for me to put a 5 star on it

Do not buy this product!  This would have been an excellent buy had the razor lasted for more than 3 months. Noticed that it was starting to bog down only a couple of minutes into a shave. This after a full charge. I see why it has only a 30 day return window and thats because they don't expect it to last that long.

reviews.t: Not that Amazon Prime deal of perfection!!
reviews.x: When my Husband first used it he was happy. He just told me today hope you didn’t pay too much for that shaver cause small pieces have broken and some have fallen off! Even though my time to return has passed, I’m very unhappy as this is the only gift I gave my Husband for Christmas.

Easy to use! Holds a long charge, easy to clean. No knicks/cuts- im so happy my husband can shave his own head without always asking for help now!!! He has african american hair and we thought this wouldnt work because his hair is so coarse and wirey but it does work well!

reviews.t: Defective product and no help from the seller
reviews.x: Ordered this shaver November 1 and opened it on Christmas. It shaves fine, but they sent me a defective charging cord, so I cannot charge it. I've left messages asking for a new cord, only to be ignored. I am unhappy and very unsatisfied with this seller.

Works great for a bald head and fits nicely in the palm of your hand but the heads fall apart when you open them for cleaning often have to spend 10 - 15 minutes trying to get it back together as the shaving heads are just held in place by tension bands.

I got it for my husband as a gift and now that it finally died and we used the charger it doesn't work :( I also don't know where else to get this charger but other than that it works great he loves it!!! very quick and close shave leaves no irritation.

reviews.t: Good but I received a bad one
reviews.x: This was actually a really good razor, unfortunately we must have received a faulty one because it charged once and After the battery had depleted, it wouldn’t charge again. Now it is fully dead and completely useless because it won’t charge.

reviews.t: I bought this to shave my completely shaved bald head
reviews.x: It's very LOUD...and along with the noisiness, this shaver is very cheaply made and doesn't get nearly as close as most other razors. It still feels like I need a shave, even after I'm finished! This was really just a waste of money.

This shaver is probably the best one out there for the price. I like the compact size and great assortment of shaver attachments. It also only took about 15 minutes of charging until it was ready to use.

reviews.t: The center peice falls out and wont go back in
reviews.x: This was a great head shaver for about 60 days and then the center blade fell out and cannot be put back in.  Not sure if there is a solutiion other than replacing the whole blade set.
I bought this for my husband for Christmas and he loves it. It gives a close shave and is easy to clean. He hasn't used the other attachments, so I can't comment on those.
The start button became too sensitive. It turns on and off sporadically upon using it. All else is good. I would rate it 5 stars if the button didn't start malfunctioning.

reviews.t: Stopped working after a few months
reviews.x: Worked fine while it lasted.  In the first month, the light stopped working.  Shortly after, the charging indicator stopped.  Now it won't take a charge at all.

reviews.t: Not completely disappointed but not thrilled
reviews.x: I am disappointed with the way it cuts my hair. Takes a long time and many passes to get head shaved properly. Usually results in my head being sore.
This unit is easy to use and awful to clean.  After only a month, one of the little compartments that you open to clean it had a door break off.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the shaver works well and delivers a good shave, especially for the price.
A common complaint is poor durability, with units breaking or stopping working after days to months of use.
Some reviewers report the shave is not close enough, requiring multiple passes over the same spot.
Several reviewers praise the 5-head design as fast and effective.
Some buyers received defective units or had charging problems, including a stuck prong and a defective cord.
